FR-014.title: Six question categories; Requirements draws only on issue text

FR-015.title: Suggested questions as fixed templates per scope and category

FR-016.title: Every answer shows references that open the code or issue

FR-017.title: Claims labelled Evidence or Inference; documented intent shown apart from inferred

FR-019.title: Unparseable answer shown as one Inference with a warning

FR-021.title: Stream raw text marked in progress, replaced by checked claims; cancellable

FR-022.title: AI provider runs read-only, workspace-confined, no network, no repo config, untrusted input delimited

FR-023.title: Each question answered by exactly one provider

FR-024.title: Business-language questions through the same interface

FR-025.title: Bitbucket Cloud, Jira Cloud, GitHub and GitHub Issues through connectors only

FR-026.title: Store references, branches and PR references with their platform

FR-027.title: Never change any PR, issue or repository on any platform

FR-029.title: Code and context only to the configured AI provider; no telemetry

FR-030.title: Reachable only from the user's machine and browser session

FR-031.title: No metric that scores, ranks or times an individual

FR-032.title: A failing source shows as a gap with its reason and blocks nothing else

FR-033.title: Show each changed file's diff with status and line counts

FR-034.title: Select a new- or old-side range or whole file as question scope

FR-035.title: Open cited lines at the head commit, removed lines at the base commit

FR-036.title: Fetch head and target only into the app-owned ref namespace, forks included

FR-037.title: Isolated workspace is a detached worktree in an app-owned directory

FR-038.title: Local merge-base diff when fetched, else platform diff; record the source and base

FR-039.title: Configure repository, clone path and tracker; config holds no credentials

FR-040.title: Separate per-platform sign-in in the keychain, checked read-only, re-prompt only the rejected platform

FR-041.title: List sessions incl. closed/merged; those open read-only

FR-042.title: Closing a session keeps the record and removes only its workspace

FR-043.title: Store and workspaces in the per-user application-data directory

FR-044.title: Confirmed whole-session delete; single questions and answers immutable

FR-045.title: Cancelled answer kept with its text as Inference, marked cancelled

FR-046.title: Show unsupported assumptions apart from claims

FR-047.title: Show suggested follow-ups; selecting one asks with the same scope

FR-048.title: Answer for Technical or Business, stored with the question

FR-049.title: File and prompt size limits, configurable, skipped files listed with reasons

FR-050.title: Answer from scope, snapshot and issues only; follow-ups add only their parent

FR-051.title: New work only on the latest snapshot; older answers marked with their head

FR-052.title: Check head on open and refresh only; snapshot only at start and refresh

FR-053.title: Auto summaries per snapshot; one summary and one question at a time per session

FR-054.title: Structured, rotated logs with no secrets, code, prompts or PR text

decisions.decision: Run TypeScript from source via Node 24 type stripping; tsc only for typecheck and the published dist
decisions.why: P.5 no build step for the dev server, no loader dependency

decisions.decision: node:sqlite review store with append-only enforced by SQLite triggers; whole-session delete via a marker row in one transaction
decisions.why: III.2 needs the store to refuse history edits even outside the store module
decisions.rejected: better-sqlite3 (native dep), JSON files (no atomic cascade)

decisions.decision: Claude Code CLI run --restricted with --tools Read,Grep,Glob and --strict-mcp-config, cwd an empty app-owned dir, worktree via --add-dir, prompt on stdin
decisions.why: Meets FR-022 (c)(d) without --bare, which refuses OAuth; empty cwd keeps the PR CLAUDE.md out; stdin avoids Windows argv limits

decisions.decision: Git via execFile with core.hooksPath set to an empty app dir; fetch into refs/prwb/* with --no-write-fetch-head; remove only own worktrees, never prune
decisions.why: worktree add runs post-checkout, and a tracked hooksPath would run PR code; prune can drop the reviewer worktree entries
decisions.rejected: isomorphic-git or nodegit; fetching into refs/remotes

decisions.decision: Launch token in URL fragment, exchanged by POST for an HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie
decisions.why: Keeps the token out of logs and history, keeps GET stateless, and lets EventSource and static assets authenticate
decisions.rejected: token in query string; bearer header only

decisions.decision: Preact UI bundled by esbuild, all PR and AI text rendered as text nodes
decisions.why: Strict CSP forbids an inline import map; text-only rendering closes XSS from PR and AI content
decisions.rejected: React with Vite; htm without a build

decisions.decision: Add failed as a final question and summary outcome
decisions.why: FR-032 and EC-02 need a provider error kept as a gap with its reason; cancelled implies a user or a restart

decisions.decision: A refresh retires older worktrees only after the work running at that moment ends, through an afterRunning(sessionId) dep wired to lanes.settledRunning
decisions.why: FR-051: running work finishes against its own snapshot; the real CLI would lose its --add-dir worktree mid-answer
decisions.rejected: per-snapshot tracking (more code for little gain); sessions importing lanes (breaks the ownership rule)

decisions.decision: Stopping the workbench cancels running AI work with reason restart
decisions.why: matches what start-up recovery records after a kill (FR-045)
decisions.rejected: reason user, which would misattribute the cancel

decisions.decision: Request log lines carry sessionId and snapshotId from matched route params, kept only when id-shaped
decisions.why: FR-054 requires session and snapshot ids; the full-session test showed none were logged
decisions.rejected: logging raw path segments, which could carry text into the log

decisions.decision: OverviewScreen children became a render function of its current detail
decisions.why: the summaries panel follows a refresh instead of showing the old snapshot
decisions.rejected: the router fetching its own copy of the detail

decisions.decision: The US2 harness gained a composed mode booting src/main.ts, with a fake browser opener on PATH
decisions.why: full-app test reuses the same fixtures and no test can open a real browser
decisions.rejected: duplicating the fixture setup in full-app.test.ts

approach: A local node:http server on 127.0.0.1 with a cookie-exchanged launch token serves a Preact UI. Core services assemble context through three provider-neutral contracts and a git-CLI Repository manager that fetches into refs/prwb/* and uses detached worktrees. The Claude Code CLI runs restricted with read and search tools only, and its output is validated into labelled claims stored append-only in node:sqlite.
